title: A system role cannot be deleted
preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list with at least one system role (for example Service Manager) visible.
steps:
1. Find the Service Manager row.
  2. Look at the Actions column.
  3. If there is a three-dot menu, open it and look for Delete.
expected: A system role cannot be deleted: either it shows only the eye icon (no three-dot menu), or the menu has no Delete, or Delete is disabled.
